title: Billing
for: subscriptions, revenue, renewals, MRR and churn for PLG and self-serve reporting

manual.export: Export customers, subscriptions or MRR movements as CSV from the billing dashboard (Stripe: Billing > Subscriptions > Export; ChartMogul: Data > Export).

vendors.name: Stripe
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__stripe`) until checked
Writes are gated by the key's `stripe_api_write` permission; a restricted key with `stripe_api_read` only makes the server read-only for scheduled pulls.
OAuth access is revocable per environment in the Stripe dashboard; admins manage which users may connect MCP clients.
A local stdio alternative exists (@stripe/mcp 0.3.3 on npm) and takes the key as an argument; the remote server is preferred.

auth.where: Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys > restricted key

cli.notes: `stripe get /v1/subscriptions --api-key <restricted key>` for scripted, headless pulls; JSON output

vendors.name: ChartMogul
capabilities: MRR, ARR, churn and LTV metrics
caveats: The local server repo (chartmogul/chartmogul-mcp-server) is archived; the remote OAuth server replaced it, so there is no headless MCP route. Use the ChartMogul API from a script for scheduled pulls.

vendors.name: Paddle
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__paddle`) until checked
Endpoint and API-key auth seen in secondary listings only; the bearer header follows the Paddle API convention, confirm on the developer docs before wiring.
A sandbox endpoint exists for testing; point the URL at it while a workflow is being built.

auth.where: Paddle dashboard > Developer tools > Authentication > API keys
